Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale or falls back to condition
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance, whitelist and balance mutations
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
Internal view that enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom
transfer delegates its execution to transferFrom
transferFrom uses msg.sender for the allowance[_from][msg.sender] check and debit
transferFrom calls ensure before mutating balances
ensure trusts the caller supplied _from for owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale whitelist bypass
ensure derives the local _UNI pair address through pairFor
ensure reads tradeAddress during whitelist evaluation
ensure reads canSale[_from] during whitelist evaluation
ensure calls condition when the sender is not whitelisted
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales
condition reads _minSale to bound the minimum value
condition reads _maxSale to bound the maximum value
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction and addition on balanceOf entries
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer
approve writes the allowance entry for the caller msg.sender
approve sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no reentrancy protection
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing the call
delegate executes an attacker supplied delegatecall with arbitrary calldata
_mints restricts execution to owner or a hardcoded privileged address based on msg.sender
_mints arbitrarily overwrites balanceOf[spender] and can mint unbacked tokens
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true to bypass the ensure whitelist
init writes _minSale using unchecked multiplication by 10**decimals
init writes _maxSale using unchecked multiplication by 10**decimals
init writes _saleNum directly from the caller supplied value
init requires msg.sender == owner before configuring sale limits
batchSend decrements and increments balanceOf entries inside a loop
batchSend loop performs unchecked multiplication and subtraction of balances
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass distributing balances
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry used by ensure
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender giving full privileged control
constructor stores msg.sender into the owner state variable
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals without SafeMath
constructor initializes balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router address
callOptionalReturn performs the low-level address(token).call(data)
the external call can re-enter callOptionalReturn and the calling token flow before state finalization

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter is only meaningful as the balance/allowance key consumed by transferFrom
The _to parameter is only used as the recipient index inside transferFrom
The _value parameter is consumed by the allowance and balance arithmetic of transferFrom
The _spender parameter is only used to index allowance in approve
The _value parameter is only written into allowance by approve
The a address is the target of the arbitrary delegatecall unsafe operation
The b calldata is passed verbatim into the delegatecall unsafe operation
The spender parameter is the key whose balance and canSale flag _mints overwrites
The addedValue parameter is the raw minted amount written into balanceOf
The saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum by init
The token parameter is scaled and stored into _minSale by init
The maxToken parameter is scaled and stored into _maxSale by init
The _tos array only drives the recipient loop of batchSend
The _value parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication and balance credits in batchSend
The addr parameter is directly assigned into the tradeAddress whitelist variable
The loop counter i exists only to iterate over the recipient array
The total local is the unchecked product _value * _tos.length subtracted from the sender balance
The _UNI local is only used inside the whitelist comparison of ensure
The _name parameter is only stored into the name state variable
The _symbol parameter is only stored into the symbol state variable
The _supply parameter is scaled into totalSupply and the owner balance in the constructor
